Resident of Masihani, P.O. & P.S.-Chhattarpur, District-Palamu, Jhakrhand... ...

sentences.text: CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Sunil Singh, Advocate For the State : M/s. Vijoy Kumar Sinha, A.P.P.
-----
03/12.11.2024 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Daltonganj Mahila P.S. Case No.
07/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376, 313, 323, 504, 506 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned C.J.M, Palamau.
3. Petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix who is a major lady aged about 23 years.
It is alleged that petitioner had promised to marry her, but later on, he refused to marry her.
4. It appears that the parties were in physical relationship since last one year.
5. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Sukesh Oraon @ Sukesh Uraon vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
